title: The Solar Panel Recycling Opportunity, and the Storage Mandate Sitting in Front of It

version_history.note: New post: the economics of solar-module recycling in India, based on two reports (CEEW, Nov 2025, and the EU-India Technical Cooperation Project/SolarPower Europe/PV CYCLE/NSEFI PV Waste Management report) uploaded by the user, plus independent research verifying the current E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022 Chapter V status for solar PV (registration/storage-to-2034-35 mandate, exempt from numeric EPR recycling targets), current MNRE installed-capacity figures, and on-the-ground solar-recycling activity (Poseidon Solar, Attero/NISE). Includes one SVG chart (P1 Mechanical vs P2 Chemical per-tonne cost/revenue/net-loss) and two comparison tables. Published directly per explicit user instruction.
